source.sourceName: Riksantikvaren – Lokaliteter, Enkeltminner og Sikringssoner OGC API

identity.officialDescription: Ristningen omfatter i alt 13 figurer, blant annet firbente dyr, en fugl, en mannsfigur og en spissoval figur, samt skålgroper.

coordinate.coordNote: Representasjonspunkt fra Riksantikvarens offisielle MultiPolygon-geometri for Kulturminne-ID 41907, objekt 41907-1. Punktet representerer helleristningsfeltet ved Sjømannsskolen på Ekeberg, ikke Karlsborgveien, Kongsveien eller Ekebergparken som helhet.

duplicateGate.conclusion: No canonical Ekeberg rock-carving-field identity exists. Existing nearby Ekeberg places represent other physical identities and scales.

methodAudit.failedAttempt: The first OGC search inspected only the first 1000 features and therefore missed object 41907-1.
methodAudit.paginationDiagnostic: A later paginated diagnostic found the official feature but also showed that the bbox query did not meaningfully constrain numberMatched in this API response.
methodAudit.finalMethod: Direct lookup of the exact official feature 41907-1, with identity assertions and coordinate derivation from that feature's official MultiPolygon geometry. No address or broad-area proxy is used.
